definitions.meaning: Furious, in a rage, mad, fierce

quotations.old_english: Nælle ðú mé woede (cf. gram, W. S. version) wosa
Woedo (gram, W. S.) wæs mé ðió widiua
Wið wédes (wéde, MS. B. v. wéde-hund) hundes slite

source_text: wéde; adj. Furious, in a rage, mad, fierce, v. wédan, II :-- Nælle ðú mé woede (cf. gram, W. S. version) wosa noli mihi molestus esse, Lk. Skt. Lind. 11, 7. Woedo (gram, W. S.) wæs mé ðió widiua molesta est mihi haec vidua, 18, 5. Wið wédes (wéde, MS. B. v. wéde-hund) hundes slite, Lchdm. i. 362, 23. Cf. Wód.
